title: BaSyx Studio app manifest, version 0
description: studio-app.json at the root of an app package. Paths are relative to the package root.

version.description: Semantic version of this app package.

studioApi.description: Semantic version range of the Studio app API the app works with, e.g. ^0.1.0.

permissions.description: What the app may do. An administrator approves these at install; every call is additionally limited by the user's own rights.

backend.description: Server-side code, run in an isolated Deno process. Requires the studio.backend permission.

sandbox.description: What the app's pages may run and reach beyond their own files. An administrator sees all of it at install. The origin lists need Studio app API 0.1.3.

webAssembly.description: Compile and run WebAssembly modules, e.g. file parsers.

workers.description: Start dedicated workers from blob: URLs, e.g. to parse large files off the page.

frameOrigins.description: Origins of pages the app embeds in frames (CSP frame-src).

connectOrigins.description: Origins of keyless public APIs the app reads with fetch (CSP connect-src). Together with webAssembly or workers, only for publishers the trust store grants remoteCode.

imageOrigins.description: Origins of images the app shows, e.g. map tiles (CSP img-src).

mediaOrigins.description: Origins of audio and video the app plays (CSP media-src).

localizedLabel.description: Text per BCP 47 language tag, e.g. { "en": "Nameplate" }.

htmlPath.description: Package-relative path of an HTML document.

scriptPath.description: Package-relative path of an ES module.

submodelView.description: A view offered next to the generic element tree for submodels with one of the semantic IDs (exact match).

columns.description: Default width as a widget on a shell's Overview, in columns of 12, per breakpoint of the Overview's width (Vuetify's names, as in v-col). A breakpoint without a value uses the nearest smaller one; without any, the view starts half wide from lg and full width below.

items.description: An origin in lower case: https://host[:port], where the host may start with one *. label followed by at least two labels (https://*.example.org), or http:// for loopback hosts (localhost, names below .localhost, 127.0.0.1) during development. IPv6 literals are not accepted: a Content Security Policy cannot name them.

module.description: A page with its own route and navigation entry. context: global (always), target (a target is open), shell (a shell is selected).

layout.description: standard (default): in a card below a header with breadcrumbs. fullPage: the frame fills the page from the navigation rail to the window's edges, without header, card or padding. Needs Studio app API 0.1.3.
